# SQLite 3.54.1

Official amalgamation: https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip

Archive SHA-256: `0a9c8e34352dad46006aa82836d5383bff9dc6bc9ce5a60553c05aa30e6ad1f9`.

`sqlite3.c` and `sqlite3.h` are unmodified upstream sources. SQLite is in the public domain; see the notice at the beginning of both files and https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html.

Compiled as C with the static runtime and linked into the GUI and history tests. No SQLite DLL, server, or runtime download is required.
